name: Banco de Sabadell, S.A.
summary: Banco de Sabadell, S.A. provides banking products and services in Spain, the United Kingdom, and Mexico. The company offers retail banking products, including investment products and medium- and long-term finance, such as consumer loans, mortgages, leasing and rental services, as well as other short-term finance; and cards and insurance products to individuals for personal use.
